_comment: THE READ ENGINE (re-pointed 2026-07-30). This was a capped, market-deviation SIDE lane; it is now the PRIMARY driver. An educated read of the fight content — the LLM-synthesised hypotheses about who wins and why — drives the bet. The market line is a SANITY CHECK (the conservative-EV floor below), not the thing to beat. Loosened DELIBERATELY: this bets on CONVICTION, not on a proven edge. It will bet more, on thinner reads, and it is not expected to be profitable — that is the accepted trade for 'gamble with education'. Still separate from the frozen v7.0.0 core in forecast-rules.json; the core never reads this file.
_enabled: The read lane is the engine now, so it is on by default (EXPLORATION_ENABLED still forces it on explicitly for tests/parity).

caps._perBout: A strong, well-argued read can now move the number a LOT (~35 points at even money) — enough to favour an underdog when the analysis is convincing. That is the whole point of 'process it like I would'. Weak or lone uncertain reads still move it only a little.

magnitudeByStrength._comment: How far a read moves the number, by how well-argued it is. ONE credible breakdown is now allowed to matter — an educated fan acts on a single convincing analyst, they do not wait for five.

discounts._probablyPriced: Public info is barely discounted now — an educated fan bets a good read whether or not the market already knows. Beating the market is no longer the goal.
discounts._contradicted: A read with contradictory evidence keeps only 30% of its weight — honesty about a shaky read stays.
discounts._reliability: Per-mechanism reliability (shrunk, from data/mechanism-reliability.json) blends in at 50% — it nudges, it never decides alone.

_creativeEligibleTopics: The topics a read legitimately turns on. Broadened from the old edge-hunting set to the full analytical read (grappling, power, momentum, experience) — this is where an educated opinion lives.

tiers._comment: Read classifications and the bankroll stakes (scaled to the live balance, not a fixed $100). Larger stake never rescues a worse read.

sizing._sizing: Stake is scaled by the PRICE (≈ win probability): FULL tier stake at even money (50c) or better, proportionally less below it (a 16c shot ~= a third of a 45c bet). A longshot loses far more often, so a flat stake on it drains the bankroll fast — conviction picks the fight, the odds size the bet. Set priceScaled:false to revert to flat tiers.

tierRequirements._comment: What a read needs to reach each tier. All tiers require a coherent causal mechanism (a REASON, not a vibe) and that the read is not fatally contradicted. The market-beating gate — 'only if the info is novel / not already priced' — is REMOVED: an educated fan bets a good read regardless of whether the market has seen it.
